name: com.allthetdu/events
title: AllTheTDU
description: Tour Down Under rides and events in Adelaide: what's on now, by day or place, race days.

tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: Events on right now and the next ones to start, at the Tour Down Under in Adelaide. Times are Adelaide time.

at.description: Optional time to ask about instead of now, in Adelaide time, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

tools.name: find_events
tools.description: Search the Tour Down Under rides and events by day, category (such as Race Stages, Official Events, Street Parties, Group Rides), tag or words. Results are in time order.

day.description: A festival day: YYYY-MM-DD, today, tomorrow, a weekday (Tue) or a date (19 Jan).

tag.description: A tag such as ride, party, family or pro team.

text.description: Words in the event name, category or place.

limit.description: Most events to return (1 to 50, default 25).

tools.name: event_details
tools.description: Everything about one event: day, time, place, map link, category, tags, details such as distance or cost, repeat days, and a link to its card on allthetdu.com.

id.description: The event id from another tool, or its name.

tools.name: events_near
tools.description: Events and shop pop-ups near a suburb, street or venue in and around Adelaide, nearest first.

place.description: A suburb, street or venue, such as Glenelg or Victoria Square.

lat.description: Latitude of the centre point, instead of a place (use with lng).

lng.description: Longitude of the centre point, instead of a place (use with lat).

radius_km.description: How far from the place to look, in kilometres (default 2).

day.description: A festival day: YYYY-MM-DD, today, tomorrow, a weekday (Tue) or a date (19 Jan).

limit.description: Most events to return (1 to 50, default 25).

tools.name: race_days
tools.description: Every men's and women's stage of the Tour Down Under: day, route, start and finish places and times, and distance.
